verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the published availability window for the online income-return correction service (open 29 July to 30 November 2026, docs-15). That is an up-front statement of when one online flow can be used. Nothing addresses daily operating hours, per-day submission limits, or session timeouts, and that window concerns personal income returns rather than a founder's professional filing flow. Missing for 10: published daily operating hours or maintenance windows for professional filing, per-day limits, session-timeout disclosure, and coverage of the professional-space flows rather than a single personal-return service.
